label: Aquinas on contact and presence in the immensity route
summary: ST I q.8 aa.1–2 supplies the immediate-contact and divine non-dimensional presence readings. Its case for divine presence concerns continuous giving of esse. The article expressly allows action at a distance through a medium. The indexed contact principle and the uncontained presence of an arbitrary generic cause of all esse are stronger applications.
blocker: Use the existing concurrence and sustaining-causation tests to identify which cases of GivesAt are immediate and which warrant inclusive IsAt. The passage itself provides no all-histories premise or derivation of uncontainment from generic CausesIn.
